records.name: IIT Madras (Electrical)
records.description: IIT Madras's Department of Electrical Engineering is one of the most productive research departments in the country, with internationally recognized work in signal processing, wireless communications, power electronics, and control systems. It offers B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs and is home to several industry-sponsored research centers. The department plays a key role in India's semiconductor ecosystem and clean energy technology research.

records.name: Government Aviation Training Institute
records.description: Government Aviation Training Institute (GATI) in Bhubaneswar is an approved flying training organization (FTO) offering Commercial Pilot License (CPL) training under DGCA regulations. It provides pilot training on modern light aircraft with experienced instructors and aims to make commercial pilot training more accessible and affordable. GATI is known for its structured training methodology and simulator-based instruction.

records.name: Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi (IGRUA)
records.description: Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi (IGRUA) in Rae Bareli is India's premier government-run flying training institute, established in 1985 under the Ministry of Civil Aviation. It offers CPL and instrument rating programs and is recognized as the gold standard for pilot training in India due to its modern fleet, state-of-the-art simulators, and professional training standards. IGRUA is the only government-owned flying academy in India and has trained thousands of commercial pilots serving Indian and international airlines.

records.name: JNU School of International Studies
records.description: Jawaharlal Nehru University's School of International Studies (SIS) in New Delhi is India's foremost institution for the study of international relations, foreign policy, and area studies. It offers M.A., M.Phil., and Ph.D. programs in international organizations, international law, disarmament, and regional studies covering East Asia, Southeast Asia, the Americas, and West Asia. SIS alumni include career diplomats, foreign policy analysts, journalists, and academics of national and international repute.

records.name: Deccan College Pune
records.description: Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute in Pune is a deemed university and one of Asia's premier institutions for archaeology, linguistics, and Indology. Established in 1821, it offers postgraduate and doctoral programs in archaeology, ancient Indian history, and linguistics, with extensive excavations and a world-renowned dictionary project. The college's museum houses one of India's richest collections of archaeological artifacts and manuscripts.

records.name: National Museum Institute
records.description: National Museum Institute (NMI) of History of Art, Conservation and Museology in New Delhi is a deemed university under the Ministry of Culture offering specialized postgraduate programs in art history, conservation, and museology. It is uniquely situated within the National Museum complex, providing students direct access to the country's foremost collection of art and antiquities for hands-on learning. NMI is the primary institution training India's museum and conservation professionals.

records.name: Archaeological Survey of India Training Institute
records.description: Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) Training Institute provides specialized training in archaeology, architectural conservation, and heritage site management for ASI officers and professionals. It conducts excavation training, conservation workshops, and field schools at protected archaeological monuments across India. The institute plays a vital role in building India's capacity for documenting, preserving, and managing its rich archaeological heritage.

records.name: Jadavpur University
records.description: Jadavpur University in Kolkata is one of India's finest research universities, recognized for excellence in engineering, science, arts, and interdisciplinary research. Its Faculty of Engineering and Technology is particularly reputed, and the university is consistently ranked among the top universities in India in NIRF rankings. Jadavpur fosters a strong research culture and has pioneered several interdisciplinary programs in environmental science, cognitive science, and film studies.

records.name: English and Foreign Languages University (EFLU)
records.description: English and Foreign Languages University (EFLU) in Hyderabad is a central university and the premier institution in India for the study of English and foreign languages, offering programs in French, German, Spanish, Russian, Arabic, Chinese, and Japanese. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in language, linguistics, literature, translation, and language teaching. EFLU is internationally recognized for its language research and teacher training programs.

records.name: Kendriya Hindi Sansthan
records.description: Kendriya Hindi Sansthan in Agra is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, dedicated to promoting the teaching and learning of Hindi as a second language across India and internationally. It offers diploma, certificate, and postgraduate programs in Hindi teaching methodology and conducts training courses for Hindi teachers from non-Hindi-speaking states. The Sansthan has regional centers in several cities and reaches over a lakh teachers annually.
